description: Drop-in equivalents for a part and alternatives that are not drop-in, optionally restricted by origin lens, plus parts it is commonly paired with. An equivalent has drop_in: true and quotes the maker's own statement (quote, source) with what still changes (note) and what to check. An alternative has drop_in: false, the interface specs that differ or are unknown (differs, unknown), what to check before swapping (check) and a summary. Never present an alternative as a substitute without its differences and checks.
name: find_equivalents

error.description: Set when the tool could not answer; the other fields are then absent.

title: Find equivalent parts
